description_en: Uploads audio and receives recognized text, agent responses, and synthesized audio over WebSocket, and supports image and text auxiliary input, recognition context, and session history. The operation description includes the complete handshake, control frames, audio frames, return events, and error handling protocols
description_zh: 通过 WebSocket 上传语音并接收识别文字、Agent 回复及合成音频，支持图文辅助输入、识别上下文和会话历史。接口说明包含完整握手、控制帧、音频帧、返回事件与错误处理协议
name: StreamVoice
